questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement multi-tenant zero-trust mTLS using SPIFFE IDs, short-lived cert rotation, and KMS-backed CA in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains per tenant
- CSR-based certificate rotation with short lifetimes
- Per-tenant mesh policies (Istio/OPA) for north-south and east-west traffic
- Workload identity verification via SPIFFE IDs

## Code Example
```yaml
# CSR bootstrap (outline)
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-td1-csr
spec:
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-clientSigner
  request: <base64-csr>
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
```

```yaml
# Per-tenant policy (outline)
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-td1-gateway
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  rules:
  - from:
    - source:
        principals: ["spiffe://td1/ns/default/sa/gateway"]
    to:
    - operation:
        methods: ["GET","POST"]
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle cert revocation in case of a compromised gateway?
- How would you test cross-tenant isolation under peak load?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Real-world upgrades in multi-tenant CNF platforms require safe, isolated releases. This tests your ability to design rollout strategies, implement metrics-based promotion decisions, and enforce cross-tenant risk controls.

## Key Concepts
- Argo Rollouts canary strategy scoped per tenant
- Tenant isolation via labels and service mesh subsets
- Per-tenant AnalysisRun with Prometheus-based SLAs
- Rollback and auto-promotion guardrails
- Minimal CRD sketches and namespace-scoped validation

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 30
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 100
      trafficRouting:
        nginx:
          stableIngress: gateway-ingress
          additionalIngressAnnotations:
            canary-by-header: X-Tenant-ID
      analysis:
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        unsuccessfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
```

## Per-Tenant AnalysisRun CRD Sketch
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-analysis
spec:
  args:
    - name: tenant-id
  metrics:
    - name: latency-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 100
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            histogram_quantile(0.99,
              sum(rate(gateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
              by (le))
    - name: error-rate-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 0.01
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}},status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
```

## One-Namespace Test Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-stable
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: stable
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-canary
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: canary
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: gateway:v2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
  strategy:
    canary:
      canaryService: gateway-canary
      stableService: gateway-stable
      trafficRouting:
        service:
          canaryWeight: 10
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 30
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 100
```

## Traffic Isolation Design
- **Service Mesh Subsets**: Each tenant gets dedicated subsets (stable/canary) in the mesh, ensuring zero cross-tenant traffic bleed
- **Tenant Labels**: All resources (Rollouts, Services, AnalysisRuns) are labeled with tenant ID for RBAC and policy enforcement
- **Network Policies**: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies restrict pod-to-pod communication to same-tenant pods only
- **Ingress Routing**: Use header-based routing (X-Tenant-ID) at the ingress to route to tenant-specific services

## Per-Tenant Metrics Collection
- Deploy tenant-scoped Prometheus instances or use Prometheus tenants
- Configure recording rules per tenant for SLI computation
- Metrics queries always include tenant filter to ensure isolation
- Store metrics with tenant label for multi-tenant querying and alerting

## Policy Enforcement
- **OPA/Gatekeeper**: Enforce that Rollouts must have tenant label and cannot modify other tenants' resources
- **Kubernetes RBAC**: Bind roles to tenant groups, limiting access to tenant-specific namespaces

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-cluster, tenant-isolated config rollouts with dynamic proxy configuration.

## Key Concepts
- Envoy xDS dynamic configuration and Aggregated Discovery Service (ADS)
- Kubernetes CRD-based policy model per tenant with isolation
- Canary traffic shaping with weight and time-based rollout window
- Multi-cluster consistency and safe rollback mechanisms
- Observability hooks for validation during rollout phases

## Code Example
```yaml
# (a) Tenant Routing Policy with Canary Weight and Rollout Window
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantRoutePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api-v2
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenant: tenant-a
  targetCluster: cluster-west
  route:
    path: /api/v2
    backendRefs:
      - name: gateway-service
        port: 8080
  canary:
    weight: 0  # Start at 0%
    rolloutDuration: 30m
    stepWeight: 10  # Increment by 10% each step
    stepInterval: 5m
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: 5  # Rollback if 5 consecutive errors exceed threshold
    errorRateThreshold: 0.05  # 5% error rate triggers rollback
  healthCheck:
    endpoint: /healthz
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
---
# (b) Sidecar Config to Watch Policy and Push Updates
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway-sidecar
  namespace: gateway-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: xds-controller
          image: cnf/xds-controller:latest
          args:
            - --policy-namespace=tenant-a
            - --xds-address=$(POD_IP):18000
            - --sync-interval=10s
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: policy-config
              mountPath: /etc/policy
              readOnly: true
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:latest
          args:
            - --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml
            - --service-cluster gateway
          volumeMounts:
            - name: envoy-config
              mountPath: /etc/envoy
      volumes:
        - name: policy-config
          configMap:
            name: tenant-policies
        - name: envoy-config
          emptyDir: {}
---
# (c) One-Namespace Test Manifest for Canary Rollout and Rollback
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: CanaryRolloutTest
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: tenant-a-api-v2
  testStages:
    - stage: baseline
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 0
      checks:
        - type: metrics
          metric: requests_total{path="/api/v2"}
          condition: equals 0
    - stage: canary_10pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 10
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/health
          expectSuccessRate: 0.95
        - type: metrics
          metric: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{cluster="backend-v2"}
          condition: exists
    - stage: canary_50pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 50
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/users
          expectSuccessRate: 0.99
    - stage: full_rollout
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 100
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/**
          expectSuccessRate: 0.999
  rollbackTest:
    enabled: true
    triggerFailureAt: canary_50pct
    expectedBehavior: weight_reverts_to_0_within_2m
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a practical tracing pipeline for multi-tenant CNF gateways, including per-tenant sampling control, data locality, and end-to-end verification.

## Key Concepts
- OpenTelemetry, OTLP, and trace attributes
- Tenant isolation via per-namespace ConfigMaps
- Sidecar instrumentation and centralized collectors
- Verification: trace presence, tenantID propagation, sampling adherence

## Code Example
```yaml
# gateway-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gateway
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: cnf/gateway:latest
          env:
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
              value: "http://otel-collector:4317"
          resources: {}
```
```yaml
# cnf-tracing-config.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf-tracing
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  tracing.enabled: "true"
  tracing.sample-rate: "0.5"
```
```yaml
# test-traffic-namespace.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: test-trace-tenant-a
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle dynamic changes to sampling rates without restart?
- What are the trade-offs of client-side vs server-side sampling in this setup?
